text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning and clear communication. First, time management is key: create a schedule and break large tasks into smaller steps so you can track your progress. Second, prioritization helps you focus on the most important work first, so you spend your energy where it matters most. Third, scope management means being realistic about what you can finish; if a task is too big, discuss reducing it early rather than missing the deadline. Finally, communication is essential — inform your team or manager as soon as problems appear, because hiding delays only makes things worse. With these habits, deadlines become easier to manage.
